results.description:
Metalstorm is an online competitive shooter where matches are decided by skill, positioning, and team coordination. Jump into real-time multiplayer battles against real players, master distinct combat roles and jets, and compete in fast-paced air combat built for serious PvP players. Played by millions of players worldwide, Metalstorm delivers modern warfare for competitive shooter fans.


Master your role, win the fight, and climb toward ace status.




COMPETITIVE 5V5 MULTIPLAYER COMBAT
Metalstorm is built for skill-based PvP and team coordination.

- Online 5v5 Battles: Fight with your squad in real-time multiplayer modes like Team Deathmatch, Air Superiority, and Elimination
- Fast Matchmaking: Jump into quick 6-minute matches with real players in seconds.
- Global Rankings: Climb the global leaderboards and prove your status as a legendary ace in our PvP modes
- Team-Based Air Combat: Master your guns and own the sky in a game built for action, not simulation


DISTINCT COMBAT ROLES & JET ABILITIES
Every aircraft in Metalstorm fills a unique combat role. Choose your playstyle and adapt your strategy with 5 distinct class roles and over 42 authentic jets to choose from like: 

- Frontline Tank (A-10 Thunderbolt): Tank damage and dominate close-range combat with iconic guns
- Stealth Assassin (JAS39 Gripen): Ambush enemies with precision strikes and vanish
- Recon Scout (F-35 Lightning): Provide overwatch for your team with battlefield intel
- Sharpshoot Sniper (F-14 Tomcat): Control airspace with multi-lock missile systems
- Tactical Support (Rafale): Disrupt enemy targeting with advanced electronic warfare


BUILD, UPGRADE, AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR ARSENAL
Progress through a deep upgrade system designed for long-term mastery and competitive balance. Modify your fleet like a real warfare strategist to fit the needs of your multiplayer team:

- Jet Stats: Upgrade speed, durability, and guns across 20 levels
- Mods: Customize jets with damage resistance, gun boosts, and high-skill maneuvering upgrades
- Unique Ability: Unlock powerful ultimate abilities that can change the course of battle
- Licensed Aircraft: Fly officially licensed aircraft from Lockheed Martin, Boeing, and Northrop Grumman, including the F-16 Fighting Falcon, F-22 Raptor, F/A-18 Super Hornet, and F-14 Tomcat


LIVE EVENTS, SEASONS & REGULAR UPDATES
The action never stops. Metalstorm is a live multiplayer game with constant new content and limited-time challenges.

- Seasonal Battle Pass: Complete missions to unlock customizations and upgrade resources
- Weekly & Limited-Time Events: Experience rotating game modes and special challenges

- Black Market: Prepare for new jet releases with squad-based challenges and event rewards


SQUAD UP WITH FRIENDS
Join a Squadron of warriors and compete together in the most social online multiplayer game on mobile. Chat strategy with teammates and climb the Squadron Leaderboards together. Whether you’re a casual action fan or a hardcore competitive shooter, Metalstorm offers a social multiplayer experience built around teamwork and progression.


EPIC MAPS & OPTIMIZED PERFORMANCE
Battle across dynamic maps designed for tactical air combat. Use terrain, cover, and altitude to outplay opponents across environments like icy arctic battlefields and high-risk nuclear facilities. Enjoy high-definition visuals and smooth performance optimized for mobile devices.


Download Metalstorm: Modern Air Combat now and experience one of the most competitive online jet PvP shooters. Jump in the cockpit and earn your place among the world’s top aces.

Pick the best planes and pilots for the job and fly over the cold Russian tundra or sunny deserts of Egypt. Fight over the Pacific Ocean and experience the war from the perspective of American and Japanese pilots.

EXPERIENCE WW2 FLIGHT COMBAT ON MOBILE LIKE NEVER BEFORE
● The best WW2 air combat game on mobile devices with intuitive controls and user-friendly flight mechanics.

results.description:
Meet the flight simulator of the next generation. Take off, fly to the airport in the city nearby &  land. Build & manage an aircraft fleet. And it’s just the beginning of what Airline Commander, one of the most realistic airplane games, has to offer!

Flying features:
- Dozens of airliners: turbine, reaction, single deck or double deck.
- Dozens of main hubs with taxiways to open thousands of routes towards all the major airports of the world.
- Hundreds of realistic airports and runways. HD satellite images, maps and worldwide navigation for every region & airport.
- Thousands of different situations to handle.
- Real-time aircraft traffic, with real airlines, on the ground and in flight.
- Simplified flight system with navigation help or flight simulation for advanced users.
- Realistic SID/STAR takeoff and landing procedures with pushback system, taxiing and the possibility to dock.
- Competition mode to prove you're the best pilot.
- Realistic different times of the day with sun, moon, stars and real-time weather conditions.
- Customizable airline livery.

Time to take off!
In this flight simulator you start as a new pilot who must learn how to fly big aircrafts. Listen to an experienced flight pilot, take off from the airport, get familiar with all the controls in the cockpit & make a safe landing. Get a pilot license & start building your own airline in one of the most realistic airplane games!

Expand your airplane fleet
Take new contracts & fly in realistic weather conditions with real-time traffic & earn money to expand your aircraft fleet. Buy new airplane. A bigger plane. Choose new flying routes, improve your skills & get a new pilot license. The more you fly in this airplane flight simulator, the more options to expand your airline fleet.

What’s wrong with this aircraft?
Like in most airplane games, not every flight is smooth… and because Airline Commander is one of the most realistic airplane simulator games, everything can go wrong. Failure of sensors, instruments, ASM, fuel tanks, landing gear & engines. Malfunction of flaps, rudder, air brakes & radar. Not to mention wind, turbulence & fog with various levels of severity… It’s a dream come true for every fan of flight simulator games who looks for an immersive, realistic experience.

A simplified flight system
Not ready for true airplane simulator experience? Airplane games don’t have to be hard. Choose a simplified flight system and ease your time with every take off & landing. Not everybody has to make a carrier landing from the start so take your time and enjoy a bit lighter take on a real flight simulator.

Customize your plane
Games from the flight simulator genre usually let you customize a plane and Airline Commander is no exception! Change the livery of every plane in your aircraft fleet and admire its look in the beautiful 3D that no other airplane games can offer.

Airline Commander - a flight simulator like no other
The newest game from the creators of RFS - Real Flight Simulator takes realism above the level of flight simulator games. Whether you’re an experienced pilot or completely new to flight simulator games, Airline Commander lets you feel the thrill of flying like no other plane games. DOWNLOAD NOW & pilot an airplane in one of the most realistic games about flying among the simulator games genre.

Support:
For problems with the game and suggestions please write to: airlinecommander@rortos.com
